title: Flash Sale Timer
content: Build flash sale countdown component. Banner style: full-width bg-red-600 or gradient. Content: sale title ("Flash Sale!"), countdown timer (days:hours:minutes:seconds), discount percentage ("Up to 70% Off"). Timer: large digits in boxes, animated flip or simple decrement. Urgency: pulsing animation, "Ends Soon" when < 1 hour. Product badge: smaller variant showing "Sale ends in 2:34:15" on product cards. Actions: "Shop Now" button.

variants.simple: Create countdown timer for flash sale with urgency styling.
variants.detailed: Build flash sale countdown component. Banner style: full-width bg-red-600 or gradient. Content: sale title ("Flash Sale!"), countdown timer (days:hours:minutes:seconds), discount percentage ("Up to 70% Off"). Timer: large digits in boxes, animated flip or simple decrement. Urgency: pulsing animation, "Ends Soon" when < 1 hour. Product badge: smaller variant showing "Sale ends in 2:34:15" on product cards. Actions: "Shop Now" button.
variants.advanced: Build flash sale countdown component with multiple variants and urgency escalation. Banner variant: full-width, bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-orange-500 or brand colors. Content layout: flex items-center justify-center gap-8 py-4 px-4, sale icon (Zap, Flame, or custom), sale title ("FLASH SALE" or "LIMITED TIME" in font-bold text-white tracking-wide), countdown timer, CTA. Countdown timer: flex gap-2, each unit (days if > 0, hours, minutes, seconds) in separate box (bg-white/20 backdrop-blur rounded-lg px-3 py-2), large number (text-3xl font-bold font-mono), label below (text-xs uppercase). Timer animation options: simple decrement, flip animation (CSS 3D transform on second change), slide animation. Separator: colon between units, optionally animated blink. Discount display: "Up to 70% OFF" or "Extra 20% Off" badge. Urgency escalation: when timer < 1 hour, add pulsing animation (animate-pulse) or color intensification, "ENDING SOON!" flashing text, when < 5 minutes, critical styling (bg-red-700), shake animation optional. Sound: optional tick sound in final minute (user preference). Product card badge: compact variant, smaller "Ends in 2:34:15" with Clock icon, positioned absolute top-right on product image, bg-red-500 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded. Product page banner: medium variant above product title, shows time remaining and sale price. Timer end behavior: when reaches 0, show "Sale Ended" message, optionally auto-redirect to regular product, or reload to reflect updated pricing. Server sync: sync timer with server time to prevent client manipulation, handle timezone correctly. Start time: if sale hasn't started, show "Starts in..." countdown instead. CTA button: "Shop Now", "View Deals" - high contrast button. Multiple sales: support different end times per product/category. Sticky bar: optionally sticky top during scroll on sale pages. Accessibility: timer should not auto-announce every second (use aria-live="polite" with less frequent updates), provide static "Sale ends at [time]" for screen readers. Mobile: stack layout, smaller timer boxes, shorter labels ("HR", "MIN", "SEC").
